candidate_name: EG-27 LNG project (Ebano field, Block EG-27)
sponsor_or_proposer: Sonagas GE (national gas company); Afreximbank as financial advisor; ConocoPhillips/GEPetrol via 2025 Heads of Agreement on Block EG-27
current_state: US$4.5bn LNG project to monetize the Ebano field (3.8 Tscf) in Block EG-27 (formerly Block R), ~2.4 MTPA over 20 years, 360 mmscf/d feed gas. Afreximbank ACMA mandated as financial advisor (announced ~July 2025); Sonagas leads; ConocoPhillips/GEPetrol/Sonagas signed a Heads of Agreement (Sept 2025) on Blocks B/4 and EG-27. Pre-FID; financing-structuring stage only.
missing_threshold_elements: Plant configuration unconfirmed (onshore liquefaction vs revived FLNG vs new train tied to Punta Europa) and precise plant location unstated in all sources; no FID; no FEED/EPC award reported; sponsor framing has shifted from the old Ophir/Golar/Schlumberger consortium to Sonagas-led. DEAD-AND-REVIVED AMBIGUITY: same Block EG-27 / former Block R / same stranded gas that GEM already tracks as the Fortuna FLNG Terminal (T100000130251, Source='block EG-27', First Proposal cancelled 2019, Second Proposal shelved 2025). Per Discovery SOP §6/§12 this is a high-similarity match with a changed sponsor, so it is NOT staged as a new_terminal; routed via qa to the Update workflow as a possible Fortuna status/timeline revision.
watch_for: FID announcement; EPC/FEED award naming a specific liquefaction technology or FLNG vessel; explicit statement that EG-27/Ebano LNG is a NEW standalone plant (and where) vs. a revival of Fortuna FLNG vs. a new train backfilling Punta Europa; ConocoPhillips/GEPetrol PSC finalization on EG-27 (expected 2026).
